# Kristina Bardysheva — ASO & App Store Conversion Designer

> Senior Graphic Designer in Warsaw, Poland with 10+ years of experience, specializing in ASO (App Store Optimization) and App Store conversion design: screenshot systems, store creatives and visual hypotheses for mobile apps, built on audience insight, ASO analytics and performance data. Currently at Appify, previously at Apalon. EU permanent work authorization; available for B2B and full-time employment.

## Best fit for roles
ASO Designer, App Store Designer, Conversion/Creative Designer for mobile apps, Senior Graphic Designer (mobile apps, app marketing), Product Marketing Designer. Also suited to teams that need store visuals plus UI, brand, 3D mascot and motion from one designer.

## Core expertise
- ASO design and analytics: high-converting App Store / store visuals backed by audience insights, behavioral patterns and performance metrics
- Screenshot systems and store creatives for iOS apps (12+ projects: photo/AI editors, collage makers, travel tracker, screen-time control, hairstyle try-on)
- UI and product presentation: intuitive interfaces and commercial presentations
- Visual identity and styling; 3D design, mascot-led storytelling and motion
- Environmental graphics (earlier career)

## Approach
- Audience- and data-driven: user psychology, analytics, market requirements
- Business-centric: creative solutions aligned with growth and conversion goals; tests hypotheses rather than following portfolio trends
- Multi-disciplinary, pixel-perfect execution

## Experience
- Senior Graphic Designer, Appify (full-time), Warsaw — Oct 2023–present
- Senior Graphic Designer, Apalon (full-time), Warsaw — Jul 2020–Oct 2023
- Web and Graphic Designer, Kino-mo, Minsk — Aug 2017–Jul 2020
- Graphic Designer, Alraunak LTD, Minsk — Mar 2016–Jul 2017

- Bachelor, Media and Visual Design, European Humanities University (Vilnius), 2011–2017
- English B1, Polish A2, Russian native
- EU permanent work authorization; B2B or full-time; based in Warsaw
